title: Representation Conditioning for Generation
title_zh: RECON is a simple method for enhancing the semantic performance of later layers in diffusion transformers, thereby accelerating training.

paragraphs.en: Representation-alignment methods effectively accelerate the diffusion transformer training. REPA, for example, uses a pretrained vision encoder to supervise an intermediate layer through an MLP projection head which is discarded after training. It aims to import semantics from the vision encoder to the diffusion backbone. While this objective is achieved at early layers by back-propagating the alignment loss, there is no guarantee that later layers , supervised by the velocity prediction loss alone, can well access such semantics. We propose a simple solution, representation conditioning (RECON), to improve semantics in later layers. During training, we feed the pretrained vision encoder tokens into later layers; during inference, because we no longer have the clean image, we reuse the MLP head (as a proxy to the vision encoder) and project its output tokens to the later layers. Our method adds no parameters and leads to much faster convergence: RECON is 63 × 63\times faster than SiT and 25 × 25\times faster than REPA. Code is available at https://github.com/saeidrazavi/RECON .

paragraphs.en: By aligning the diffusion model with an external vision encoder, the assumption is that the diffusion backbone will effectively access and use the semantic features, so that generation will eventually improve. In this work, we examine the alignment between the vision encoder features and features of each layer of the diffusion transformer, and the feature from g ϕ g_{\phi} . We find that the feature from g ϕ g_{\phi} has the highest level of alignment with the vision encoder, as shown in Fig. 2 b . This finding is not surprising, because g ϕ g_{\phi} is physically closest to the vision encoder and is directly optimized to minimize alignment loss.
paragraphs.zh: 通过将扩散模型与外部视觉编码器对齐，我们假设扩散主干网络能够有效地获取并使用语义特征，从而最终提升生成效果。 在本研究中，我们检验了视觉编码器特征与扩散变换器每一层特征之间的对齐关系，以及来自 g ϕ g_{\phi} 的特征。 我们发现，来自 g ϕ g_{\phi} 的特征与视觉编码器的对齐程度最高，如图 2 b 所示。 这一发现并不令人意外，因为 g ϕ g_{\phi} 在物理结构上最接近视觉编码器，并且是直接通过最小化对齐损失进行优化的。

paragraphs.en: Surprisingly, despite its strong alignment with the vision encoder, existing methods typically discard the projection head g ϕ g_{\phi} after training, as shown in Fig. 1 a . We argue that the practice is a waste of model resources including learned weights and semantics: the full potential of representation alignment is not achieved.

paragraphs.en: We introduce a very simple fix, named REpresentation CONditioning (RECON). Our idea is that instead of removing g ϕ g_{\phi} after training, we keep it and use it as a proxy of the vision encoder during inference, so that strong semantics from g ϕ g_{\phi} can be explicitly used to benefit generation. Specifically, during inference, RECON pools the g ϕ g_{\phi} output features into semantic tokens , concatenates them with the patch tokens, and lets the diffusion backbone attend to both types of tokens. Correspondingly, we have a small modification for training recipe: during training, the semantic tokens directly come from the vision encoder and serve as condition for the backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种非常简单的修复方法，名为“表示条件化”（REpresentation CONditioning，简称 RECON）。 我们的思路是：在训练结束后，不删除 g ϕ g_{\phi}，而是将其保留并在推理阶段用作视觉编码器的代理，从而能够显式利用来自 g ϕ g_{\phi} 的强语义信息来促进生成。 具体而言，在推理阶段，RECON 会将 g ϕ g_{\phi} 的输出特征聚合成语义标记，并将其与图像块标记拼接，然后让扩散模型的主干网络同时关注这两类标记。 相应地，我们对训练流程也做了一个小修改：在训练期间，语义标记直接来自视觉编码器，并作为主干网络的条件输入。

paragraphs.en: Representation alignment. REPA ( Yu et al., 2025 ) is a representative work. DDT ( Wang et al., 2026 ) builds the separation into the architecture, dividing the transformer into a semantic encoder and a velocity decoder and applying the alignment loss to the encoder output. VA-VAE ( Yao et al., 2025 ) moves the alignment out of the generator into the latent space. REPA-E ( Leng et al., 2025 ) makes joint optimization of VAE and diffusion backbone possible. What is common in all these works is discarding the projection head after training, which, as we argue, is not optimal. Another line of works relies on the supervisory signal from the model itself rather than external vision encoder. SRA ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) distills the representation of a later layer at low noise into an earlier layer at high noise. Self-Flow ( Chefer et al., 2026 ) instead creates information asymmetry across tokens by assigning them different noise levels, so the model has to infer corrupted tokens from cleaner ones. We provide a more detailed related-work discussion in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: Relation to REG. REG ( Wu et al., 2025 ) adds a representation token and diffuses it jointly with the patch tokens, so the token is generated from noise alongside the image while the alignment projector is still discarded. REG performs best when aligning with the encoder class token. This is a limitation because not every vision encoder has the class token. In comparison, RECON does not have this requirement and thus can work well with various vision encoders. Moreover, RECON does not add new variables to be diffused.
paragraphs.zh: 与 REG 的关系。 REG（Wu 等人，2025）添加了一个表示标记，并将其与图像块标记一起进行扩散，因此该标记是与图像一同从噪声中生成的，而对齐投影器则仍然被舍弃。 在与编码器类标记对齐时，REG 的表现最佳。 这是一个局限性，因为并非所有视觉编码器都包含类标记。 相比之下，RECON 没有这一要求，因此可以与多种视觉编码器良好配合使用。 此外，RECON 不会添加需要扩散的新变量。

paragraphs.en: Overview. The key is to retain g ϕ ​ ( h ) g_{\phi}(h) . At inference, we fuse the output of g ϕ ​ ( h ) g_{\phi}(h) with the diffusion patch tokens, which serves as in-context conditioning for the later diffusion layers. Before fusion, the g ϕ ​ ( h ) g_{\phi}(h) output is pooled into a few semantic tokens . During training, we directly use the vision encoder features and pool them into semantic tokens, called teacher forcing , because the projection layer is being trained and thus not stable. Using perception model features for training and projected features for inference creates a distribution gap. We mitigate this through a time-dependent scheduling for semantic token injection . Overall framework is depicted in Fig. 1 b and 1 c . We detail these components below.
paragraphs.zh: 概述。 关键在于保留 g ϕ ​ ( h ) g_{\phi}(h) 。 在推理阶段，我们将 g ϕ ​ ( h ) g_{\phi}(h) 的输出与扩散补丁标记融合，这为后续的扩散层提供了上下文条件。 在融合之前，g ϕ ​ ( h ) g_{\phi}(h) 的输出会被池化为几个语义标记。 在训练阶段，我们直接使用视觉编码器特征并将其池化为语义标记，这被称为“教师强制”，因为投影层仍在训练中，因此尚不稳定。 在训练时使用感知模型特征，而在推理时使用投影后的特征，会产生分布差异。 我们通过一种随时间变化的语义标记注入调度机制来缓解这一问题。 整体框架如图 1b 和 1c 所示。 我们将在下文详细说明这些组件。

paragraphs.en: Teacher forcing. During training, we build semantic tokens from the vision encoder features y 0 y_{0} (Eq. 5 ), because we have access to the clean image. This is the same teacher forcing method as language models: the model is conditioned on the ground truth tokens rather than on its own predictions. We could also use g ϕ g_{\phi} output to obtain semantic tokens. But we choose teacher forcing because g ϕ g_{\phi} is being trained. Its output starts far from y 0 y_{0} and keeps changing as training proceeds. Therefore, conditioning on the g ϕ g_{\phi} output would ask the later layers to rely on a signal that is neither accurate nor stable, whereas y 0 y_{0} is stable from the first training step. paragraphs.en: Implementation details. We follow the setup of SiT ( Ma et al., 2024 ) and REPA ( Yu et al., 2025 ) unless stated otherwise. paragraphs.en: C2I: system-level comparisons. Following RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , we use Autoguidance ( Karras et al., 2024 ) for the guided results (more details in Appendix B ). Table 2 summarizes the comparisons. At 80 epochs, RECON reaches 2.09, better than MaskDiT (2.28) and DiT (2.27), which are trained for 1600 and 1400 epochs, respectively. At 480 epochs, RECON reaches 1.49, better than SiT (2.06) and on par with REPA with scheduled CFG (1.42), which are trained for 1400 and 800 epochs, respectively. Similar to RAE, our preliminary observation is that CFG helps RECON less than it helps standard diffusion transformers. Designing guidance for semantically rich diffusion backbones, such as RECON and RAE, is a promising future direction, which we discuss in Sec. 7 .

paragraphs.en: Effectiveness of RECON for different VAEs. We compare RECON and REPA on three VAEs: SD-VAE ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , VA-VAE ( Yao et al., 2025 ) and InVAE ( Leng et al., 2025 ) . Results are in Fig. 8(b) . RECON yields consistent improvements over REPA for each tokenizer: gFID improves from 7.84 → 3.25 7.84\to 3.25 on SD-VAE, from 7.41 → 4.78 7.41\to 4.78 on InVAE, and from 4.95 → 4.02 4.95\to 4.02 on VA-VAE. The improvement on VA-VAE is smaller because it is trained with an additional REPA loss, so a part of the semantics RECON tries to inject into the diffusion backbone is already available. For further discussions see Appendix G .
paragraphs.zh: RECON 在不同 VAE 上的有效性。 我们在三种 VAE 上比较了 RECON 和 REPA：SD-VAE（Rombach 等人，2022）、VA-VAE（Yao 等人，2025）和 InVAE（Leng 等人，2025）。 结果见第 8(b) 图。 对于每种分词器，RECON 都比 REPA 带来了稳定的改进：在 SD-VAE 上，gFID 从 7.84 提升至 3.25（7.84\to 3.25）；在 InVAE 上，从 7.41 提升至 4.78（7.41\to 4.78）；在 VA-VAE 上，从 4.95 提升至 4.02（4.95\to 4.02）。 VA-VAE 上的改进幅度较小，因为它在训练时引入了额外的 REPA 损失，因此 RECON 试图注入扩散主干模型的部分语义已经存在。 更多讨论请参见附录 G。

paragraphs.en: Ablations and variations on design components. Table 8 varies the components RECON introduces, one block at a time: the alignment depth, the number of semantic tokens, the injection threshold t max t_{\max} , and the dimension-matching mechanism. For t max t_{\max} , we choose 0.5. Larger t max t_{\max} makes diffusion exposed to unseen semantics during inference; smaller t max t_{\max} makes it harder for diffusion blocks to understand how patch-tokens should interact with semantics. We choose k k to be 1. If we increase k k , errors in g ϕ g_{\phi} prediction are amplified and can harm the generation quality. For the dimension-matching mechanism , we choose zero-padding to increase the dimensions of semantic tokens to be the same as patch tokens. This method is easier and appears to be more effective than linear mapping. Depth of alignment analysis suggests that for XL models, Layer 8 is a good choice for alignment. It is also worth mentioning that RECON performance is relatively stable within a reasonable range of this factor.
paragraphs.zh: 设计组件的消融实验与变体。 表 8 依次调整 RECON 引入的各个组件：对齐深度、语义标记数量、注入阈值 t max t_{\max} 以及维度匹配机制。 对于 t max t_{\max}，我们选择 0.5。 较大的 t max t_{\max} 会使扩散模型在推理过程中暴露于未见的语义信息；较小的 t max t_{\max} 则使扩散模块更难理解补丁标记与语义之间的交互方式。我们将 k k 设为 1。 如果增大 k k，g ϕ g_{\phi} 预测中的误差会被放大，从而可能损害生成质量。 对于维度匹配机制，我们选择零填充，将语义标记的维度提升至与补丁标记相同。 这种方法比线性映射更简单，且似乎更为有效。 对齐分析的深度表明，对于 XL 模型而言，第 8 层是进行对齐的合适选择。 同样值得注意的是，在合理范围内，RECON 的性能对此因素的变化表现出相对稳定性。

paragraphs.en: Why do later layers need more semantics? Later layers are only supervised by the flow-matching loss and only depend on h h . In comparison, the gradient of REPA loss is back-propagated to early layers, so early layers are optimized towards higher semantics. By injecting semantics to late layers, the late layers, through training, can decide whether to use them or not, which is at least not detrimental and turns out to be beneficial.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么后续层需要更多的语义信息？ 后续层仅由流匹配损失进行监督，并且只依赖于 h h。 相比之下，REPA 损失的梯度会反向传播到早期层，因此早期层会被优化以产生更丰富的语义信息。 通过向后续层注入语义信息，这些后续层在训练过程中可以自行决定是否使用这些信息，这至少不会造成负面影响，并且事实证明是有益的。

paragraphs.en: Rethinking guidance for semantically rich diffusion models. CFG helps RECON less than it helps standard diffusion transformers. Our hunch is that with the semantic tokens, the backbone is already rich in semantics without the class label, so the unconditional prediction is close to the conditional one. RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) reports a similar observation, and like RAE, we use Autoguidance ( Karras et al., 2024 ) . We further improve Autoguidance with two simple changes at sampling time, Projected Autoguidance (Appendix C.1 ) and Semantic Token Extrapolation (Appendix C.2 ). They improve gFID from 2.26 → 2.09 2.26\to 2.09 at 80 epochs and from 1.80 → 1.49 1.80\to 1.49 at 480 epochs. We see these as first steps. One promising direction is Internal Guidance ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , which uses an intermediate layer of the model as the weak model. Another is guidance that acts directly on the semantic tokens, rather than on the velocity.

paragraphs.en: Limitations. RECON reuses a projection head that a REPA-style alignment loss has already trained, so it cannot be applied to a model trained without such a loss. What it removes is the waste in discarding that head, not the need for alignment in the first place. More in Appendix F .
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 RECON 重用了投影头，而该投影头已经通过 REPA 风格的对齐损失进行了训练，因此它无法应用于未使用此类损失的模型。 它所消除的是丢弃该投影头所带来的浪费，而非最初就需要对齐这一事实。更多细节见附录 F。

paragraphs.en: This paper challenges the practice in representation alignment methods that the projection head g ϕ g_{\phi} should be discarded after training. This is based on our observation that the output of g ϕ g_{\phi} is very semantical: it aligns with the vision encoder more strongly than any of the diffusion transformer layers. Discarding it means we forfeit useful and also free cues. We propose representation conditioning (RECON), which supplies output of g ϕ g_{\phi} to the later layers. With no added parameters and no change in training loss, RECON simply lets later layers decide how to use the conditioning semantics. We report good improvement over REPA in various settings. We hope that RECON was effective in conveying and bringing up the following message: what matters in representation alignment is not only acquiring a representation, but also keeping it accessible in generation.
paragraphs.zh: 本文对表示对齐方法中“训练后应丢弃投影头 g ϕ g_{\phi}”的做法提出了质疑。 这一观点基于我们的观察：g ϕ g_{\phi} 的输出具有很强的语义性——它与视觉编码器的对齐程度，比任何扩散变换器层都更强。 丢弃它意味着我们放弃了有用且无需额外成本的线索。 我们提出了表示条件化（RECON），该方法将 g ϕ g_{\phi} 的输出提供给后续层。 RECON 无需增加参数，也无需改变训练损失，只需让后续层自行决定如何运用这些条件语义。 我们在多种设置中报告了 REPA 的显著改进。 我们希望 RECON 能有效传达并强调以下观点：在表示对齐中，重要的不仅是获得一种表示，还要确保它在生成过程中可被有效利用。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion transformers. DiT ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) replaced the U-Net of latent diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) with a transformer and showed that generation quality improves with model compute. SiT ( Ma et al., 2024 ) keeps the DiT architecture and trains it with the interpolant framework, which is the setting we follow. Other works change the architecture or add objectives during training: U-ViT ( Bao et al., 2023 ) adds long skip connections between shallow and deep blocks, DiffiT ( Hatamizadeh et al., 2024 ) makes self-attention time-dependent, and MDT ( Gao et al., 2023 ) , MaskDiT ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) and SD-DiT ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) add masking or self-supervised objectives. For text-to-image generation, MMDiT ( Esser et al., 2024 ) keeps text and image tokens in separate streams that interact through joint attention.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散变换器。 DiT（Peebles & Xie，2023）用变换器取代了潜在扩散模型（Rombach et al.，2022）中的 U-Net，并证明了生成质量会随着模型计算能力的提升而改善。 SiT（Ma et al.，2024）保留了 DiT 架构，并使用插值框架对其进行训练，这也是我们所遵循的设置。 其他研究在训练过程中改变了架构或增加了目标：U-ViT（Bao et al.，2023）在浅层和深层块之间添加了长跳跃连接；DiffiT（Hatamizadeh et al.，2024）使自注意力机制具有时间依赖性；而 MDT（Gao et al.，2023）、MaskDiT（Zheng et al.，2024）和 SD-DiT（Zhu et al.，2024）则增加了掩码或自监督目标。 在文本到图像生成中，MMDiT（Esser et al.，2024）将文本和图像标记保留在独立的流中，并通过联合注意力进行交互。

paragraphs.en: Pretrained representations in the latent space. Instead of aligning the generator, some works build the semantics into the latent space itself. VA-VAE and REPA-E (Section 2 ) align or fine-tune the VAE. paragraphs.en: Train–inference gaps and forcing strategies. Conditioning a model on information during training that is not available at inference is a well-known problem. In autoregressive video diffusion, teacher forcing conditions on context that the model must later produce itself, and Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) closes the resulting gap by rolling out the model during training. RECON has the same kind of gap: it uses teacher forcing, conditioning on vision encoder features during training and on the output of g ϕ g_{\phi} at inference. We reduce this gap with time-dependent scheduling for semantic token injection (Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 训练–推理差距与强制策略。 在训练期间让模型以推理时无法获取的信息为条件，是一个众所周知的问题。 在自回归视频扩散中，教师强制机制会基于模型后续必须自行生成的上下文进行条件约束，而自我强制（Huang 等人，2025）通过在训练期间运行模型来弥合由此产生的差距。 RECON 也存在类似的差距：它在训练期间使用教师强制机制，以视觉编码器特征为条件；而在推理时则以 g ϕ g_{\phi} 的输出为条件。 我们通过为语义标记注入采用时间依赖的调度策略来缩小这一差距（第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Further implementation details. We build on the official REPA implementation, which follows SiT ( Ma et al., 2024 ) . We use AdamW with a constant learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.999) and no weight decay, and train with mixed precision (fp16) and gradient clipping. We pre-compute the SD-VAE latents and apply no data augmentation. As in REPA, the projection head g ϕ g_{\phi} is a three-layer MLP with SiLU activations. Table 10 lists the full setup.

paragraphs.en: Patch size per tokenizer. For the tokenizer study (Table 11 ), we keep the XL backbone fixed and only change its patch size, so that every run processes the same number of tokens. SD-VAE ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) downsamples the 256 × 256 256\times 256 image by 8 and gives a 32 × 32 × 4 32\times 32\times 4 latent. We therefore use a patch size of 2 (SiT-XL/2). VA-VAE ( Yao et al., 2025 ) and InVAE ( Leng et al., 2025 ) downsample by 16 and give a 16 × 16 × 32 16\times 16\times 32 latent. Following REPA-E, we use a patch size of 1 for them (SiT-XL/1). In both cases, the transformer processes 16 × 16 = 256 16\times 16=256 patch tokens, so the sequence length and compute per step are the same across the three tokenizers.

paragraphs.en: Predicted semantic tokens across noise levels. During training, the semantic token comes from the DINOv2 features of one real image (teacher forcing, Section 5.1 ). During sampling, it is predicted by the projection head g ϕ g_{\phi} from the noisy input, and how specific this prediction is depends on the noise level. At low noise levels, the semantics of the image are easy to extract, so the predicted token is specific to the sample. At high noise levels, it is hard to tell what the final image will look like, so the predicted token is close to the average token of the class and is less specific to the sample. As a result, at high noise levels the predicted semantic token is more typical of its class than the token of the final generated image.
paragraphs.zh: 不同噪声水平下的预测语义标记。 在训练阶段，语义标记来自一张真实图像的 DINOv2 特征（教师强制法，第 5.1 节）。 在采样阶段，该标记由投影头 g ϕ g_{\phi} 从含噪输入中预测，而预测的具体程度取决于噪声水平。 在低噪声水平下，图像的语义易于提取，因此预测的标记与具体样本相关。 在高噪声水平下，难以判断最终图像会呈现何种形态，因此预测的标记接近该类别的平均标记，与具体样本的相关性较低。 因此，在高噪声水平下，预测的语义标记比最终生成图像的标记更能代表其所属类别的典型特征。

paragraphs.en: We follow the linear probing protocol of MAE ( He et al., 2022 ) . For each layer, we take the frozen features of the 400K-iteration EMA checkpoint at t = 0.25 t=0.25 . We use the null class label, so that no label information leaks into the features. As for CKNNA, we average the patch tokens to get one vector per image, and discard RECON’s semantic tokens before pooling. The classifier is a BatchNorm layer without affine parameters, followed by a linear layer. We train it on the ImageNet-1K training set and report top-1 accuracy on the validation set. Unlike the original recipe, which trains for 90 epochs, we train the classifier for 20 epochs to reduce the cost of probing every layer. REPA and RECON use the same schedule, so the comparison between them is fair.

paragraphs.en: Fidelity–diversity balance. RECON strongly improves sample fidelity. At 80 epochs, it increases the precision of SiT-XL/2 ( 0.70 → 0.81 0.70\to 0.81 ) and IS ( 125.4 → 204.2 125.4\to 204.2 ), while recall decreases ( 0.65 → 0.56 0.65\to 0.56 ) (Table 8 ). Our hunch is that strong semantic conditioning makes the model commit to clear class semantics early, which leaves less room for variation. paragraphs.en: Is the gain bottlenecked by the tokenizer? RECON improves generation on all three tokenizers, but by different amounts (Table 11 ). FID goes from 7.84 → 3.25 7.84\to 3.25 on SD-VAE and 7.41 → 4.78 7.41\to 4.78 on InVAE, but only from 4.95 → 4.02 4.95\to 4.02 on VA-VAE. VA-VAE is the only tokenizer trained with an alignment loss, so its latent already contains part of the semantics that RECON adds. In other words, RECON helps most when the latent has no semantic structure of its own. We do not yet know why the remaining gain on VA-VAE is small. One possibility is that the tokenizer itself limits how much can be gained. Another is that our semantic token, a single pooled summary of the image, is not the right signal for a latent that is already semantically organized, and a signal with information that the latent does not contain could still help. Telling these two apart would show whether RECON is close to its limit on such tokenizers, or whether a different way of injecting semantics could give further gains.

paragraphs.en: In Section 6.4 , we show that RECON decides the structure of a sample earlier in generation. Here we test a related question: can the model recover an image from heavy corruption? We take three clean images and corrupt each with heavy noise, moving it along the interpolant to t = 0.8 t=0.8 , so the input is 80% noise and 20% image. Then we let REPA and RECON (SiT-XL/2) denoise it. Both start from the same noisy latent and share the class label, the sampling noise and the sampler (Euler–Maruyama, 200 steps, without CFG), so any difference comes from the model. Fig. 9 shows the clean-image estimate x ^ 0 ​ ( t ) \hat{x}_{0}(t) along the way. RECON commits to the subject within the first few steps and then refines it, while the estimates of REPA stay blurry for much longer. As a result, RECON recovers the identity and layout of the original image better. Since most of the input is noise, neither model reconstructs it exactly; the difference is in how fast and how well a plausible image is formed.
paragraphs.zh: 在第 6.4 节中，我们证明了 RECON 在生成过程的早期阶段就决定了样本的结构。 在此，我们测试一个相关问题：模型能否从严重损坏的图像中恢复出原始图像？ 我们选取三张清晰的图像，对每张图像施加严重的噪声干扰，并沿插值路径将其移动至 t = 0.8，此时输入由 80% 的噪声和 20% 的图像组成。 接着，我们让 REPA 和 RECON（SiT-XL/2）对图像进行去噪处理。 两者均从相同的含噪潜在表示开始，并共享类别标签、采样噪声和采样器（Euler–Maruyama，200 步，无 CFG），因此任何差异都源于模型本身。 图 9 展示了在此过程中对清晰图像 x ^ 0 ​ ( t ) 的估计值 \hat{x}_{0}(t)。 RECON 在最初几步内就锁定了主体对象，随后对其进行优化；而 REPA 的估计结果则长时间保持模糊。 因此，RECON 能更好地恢复原始图像的身份特征和布局。 由于输入大部分是噪声，两种模型都无法完全精确地重建原始图像；差异在于它们生成合理图像的速度和效果。
